'''Dengar876 A Hidden Bounty''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Dengar876]]
* '''Published:''' 16 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor Vile Dengar876 DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Note: This deck is only using cards Thru Coruscant

A Court deck using Hidden Weapons and major force recovery and retrievial as well as lots and lots of bounty hunters and aliens.

== Strategy ==

Note: This deck is only Thru Coruscant, do not tell me to add Theed Palace or Refelection 3 cards!!!!!!

From my experience the biggset problem with bounty hunters is a high deploy cost with little forfeit, so I added some cards for attrition and destiny but still have positive imput into my deck these include:

Wed15-17 'Septoid Droid

Rodian x2

Twi'lek Advisor x2

Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo? (V)

How to play this deck is based upon your opponent's deck and your starting hand.

If they are playing with a space deck:

establish a foundation on tatooine, pull out starships with your objective, force drain on tatooine and try to survive long enough in space and do enough damage with your drains, also if they have lando or han or another smuggler, throw death mark down, it should cripple their deck along with your drains and objective. Once you get Tatooine pull out the Tatooine docking bay and then you can use guys on tatooine to refill the pilot Use your objective to pull Zuccus in Mist Hunter out and then base the rest of what u pull on your hand. Use 4-Lom, Guri and Xizor in ships and throw Fett in Mist Hunter if you can't get 4-Lom out. Lateral Damage is also a great combo to paralye a lone ship right before attacking.

If they have a ground deck:

Make sure you control Audience Chamber, they will most likly try to go to pit of carkoon if they will go to tatooine. If they do throw down Scarlac and laugh as they get eaten. Throw down Lye-Me to get Fett down for free, that is huge, use Audience's game text to pull out Mighty Jabba if u don't get him otherwise pull xizor, snoova, dengar, or lye-me. Using Power of the Hutt pull Boelo, Ephant Mon, and then the Sail Barge. The point of the barge is so you can feed captives to scarlac and not get eaten yourself. Use a Maldorian Armor on Snoova if you get them both, 9 power, armor 5, immune to attrition <3, or Bane Malar. If you get rodians put them with a bounty hunter and assuming Beedo is at audience chamber they are power 4 and add a power for each bounty hunter. If they try to block your drains with spies use Defensive Fire & Hutt Smooch. Only use Arica if you will be fine with Skum and Villiany being suspended because she will suspend it. Any jedi will be almost as good for you as it is for them, use Kithaba, power=1+ opponen'ts highest ability present, if they have a saber use Aurra Sing. Try to move to their sites using the docking bays to capture someone if they won't come to you. Hidden Weapons is an awsome card against cards with high ability, targeting them if destiny 4 or 5 target hit 2-3 captured, and with all wrapped up if they forfeit the hit character you can capture it so 2-5 will capture it. You also can use Snoova's Vibro Axe to capture.

If you can get Mighty Jabba, Ephant Mon, and Boelo all together at Audience Chamber you should be able to control it, because you would have 10 power + 2 destiny, can cancel one of their destiny and have 10 ability.

When Playing agains EBO, throw Jodo and Fett on North Ridge, and you can move up to 3 sites away with their jet packs, then you can use hidden weapons to capture their characters, and then can control Hoth while battling them in space using the space strategy.

Against Han and Chewie one of the most common combos use:

Furry Fury,

Bane Malar is awsome against chewie, gets 6 power and game text for 1 force.

and Lye-Me will subtract 3 power from their total power, and another for every other musician present(Kithaa is a Musician).

Note: This deck is only Thru Coruscant, do not tell me to add Theed Palace or Refelection 3 cards!!!!!!
